note: The curated source store. Each item records what it is, where it is published, its licence and what Agere keeps from it. Agere keeps short summaries in its own words and public code lists, never the text of a copyrighted paper. 'verified_against_source' is false until the item has been checked against the published text (2026-11-17: written from the curator's knowledge of the published sources; no source has been downloaded yet, pending the owner's approval of downloads).
